title: Testosterone Recovery after Androgen Deprivation Therapy in Prostate Cancer: Differential Effects of Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonist Monotherapy and Maximal Androgen Blockade.
publicationName: The world journal of men's health
journalName: The world journal of men's health
snippet: Testosterone recovery after androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) cessation is clinically important because prolonged hypogonadism may affect metabolic, cardiovascular, skeletal, and quality-of-life outcomes in prostate cancer.
